summary.storyTitle: Story 3: Message Projection and Token Estimates
summary.implementedScope: Fixed F-03-002. openThreadDatabase now performs an identity check before any migration runs: a read-only probe (so the probe itself cannot mutate an invalid file) requires schema version >= 1, a thread_metadata table, and the metadata singleton row that thread creation writes transactionally. Files failing the check — an empty database, an unrelated SQLite database, a non-database file — are rejected as caller_error/thread_not_found ('exists but is not an lhc thread file') with no lhc tables created and user_version untouched; SQLite's 'not a database' refusal is classified as the same identity failure, while other open errors remain system_error. The opener's signature changed to OpResult<DatabaseSync> so the rejection flows through the standard result contract, and all three call sites (runMessageEvents, runListEvents, listMessages) propagate it. Valid Story 2 user_version=1 files pass the check (they carry the metadata row) and still migrate lazily to v2, so F-03-001 behavior is preserved — all prior migration tests stay green. Three focused tests prove rejection-without-mutation for an existing empty file (verifier's exact probe), an unrelated SQLite database with foreign data, and a plain text file.
summary.acceptanceRationale: Story-lead scoped acceptance is ready for impl-lead review and outer acceptance.

evidence: Valid Story 2 files migrate to v2 before Story 3 write/read paths; focused migration tests and gates passed.
Existing non-thread files are rejected as caller_error/thread_not_found without mutation; focused tests and independent TSX probe passed.

changedFiles.reason: Added validateThreadFile (read-only identity probe: version >= 1, thread_metadata table, singleton row) run before migrations; openThreadDatabase now returns OpResult<DatabaseSync>, rejecting non-thread files as caller_error/thread_not_found and wrapping environment failures as system_error
runMessageEvents and runListEvents consume the opener's OpResult, returning the rejection instead of opening/migrating arbitrary files
listMessages consumes the opener's OpResult, so read-back on a non-thread file fails instead of adopting the file

Added an F-03-002 describe block: three rejection tests asserting error class/code and, below the SDK, unchanged user_version, no lhc tables created, foreign data and raw bytes intact; F-03-001 tests unchanged above it
Re-recorded thread-migration.test.ts hash after appending the F-03-002 tests
